verdict.rationale: Anytype clearly versions its API: dated releases (2025-11-08, 2025-05-20, 2025-04-22), a version picker covering API v1 and a v2 pre-release, a changelog, and an OpenAPI spec carrying a version field. However, the docs explicitly state there is no written deprecation policy page, so the second half of the story is unmet. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset or support windows for old versions), and independent corroboration of version stability in practice.
